dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, faint dark-grey longitudinal streaks primarily localized on the left dorsal flank.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the faint pigmented streaks and the primary light-grey canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint dark longitudinal scratches on the left dorsal plane and a distinct short horizontal white mark posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial longitudinal rake marks on the left side and a transverse white scar located immediately posterior to the blowhole.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced reflective white highlight along the central posterior dorsal ridge.
